notes: callee lms_calc not inlinable (callee with non-scalar parameter): treated as an opaque call
callee lms_init not inlinable (call without a scalar result used as a value): treated as an opaque call
callee lms_main not inlinable (opaque call with computed arguments: lms_calc): treated as an opaque call
callee lms_return not inlinable (non-integer type double): treated as an opaque call
callee lms_sinus not inlinable (callee with non-scalar return type): treated as an opaque call
